narrative: The tables lie open by the window. Three lines stand on the leaf, and the rest is bare. Frost is on the green beyond the glass. The second line is a count, not a sum of money. The pen has not gone back to add a name. The third line stops. The pen is set down on the bare part of the leaf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the three lines and stopped.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
